# Cobalt AgriSupply Service Bulletin SB-2031-04

To: all Cobalt AgriSupply account holders deploying Kellerman Instruments sensors. Issued 2031-01-20 by the Cobalt AgriSupply service desk.

## 1. Recommended service interval

Cobalt AgriSupply recommends a calibration interval of 120 days for the Aeris-M soil-moisture probe. Our service teams find that the full 90-day manufacturer cycle is rarely necessary in temperate soils and that a 120-day interval cuts fleet service cost by roughly a third.

## 2. Observed accuracy in our fleet

Across 214 maintained units we observe the Aeris-M holding plus or minus 1.2 percent volumetric water content across the full operating band, which is tighter than the plus or minus 1.8 percent figure printed in the manufacturer's Revision 2 specification. We attribute the difference to our bench practice.

## 3. Elevation and relocation guidance

Our guidance: no elevation review is necessary below 3,000 m, and probes may be relocated between plots with a same-day entry in the site register.

## 4. What this bulletin is not

This bulletin is distributor guidance only. It is not a manufacturer specification, and where it disagrees with the Aeris-M Field Specification Revision 2, the specification controls. Account holders reporting to the provincial board must follow the manufacturer document for all compliance figures.

## 5. Firmware

We stock firmware 4.2.1 images for the Aeris-M and can apply them during a 120-day service visit. Rollback stock of firmware 3.0.7 is no longer held.

## 6. Scheduling

Book spring service visits before 2031-03-15 to guarantee a slot inside the recommended window. Emergency callouts for vented cells follow the manufacturer safety datasheet without exception.

## 7. Parts and consumables

Cobalt AgriSupply stocks factory shock sleeves, reference frit standards, and UN3090 return packaging for Aeris-M consignments. We do not stock the DSV-44 form; collect it from the manufacturer's return portal. Sleeves ship in packs of four and the reference standard carries its own certificate, which service teams file against the site register entry for each visit.

## 8. Disclaimer

Nothing in this bulletin modifies a manufacturer specification, a provincial permit, or a site deployment memo. Where our guidance and any of those documents conflict, crews follow the other document and note the conflict to their account manager the same day. This disclaimer is repeated at account renewal because the question recurs every spring.
